code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    lanes = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if sum(v != 0 for v in row) < 5:
            continue
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if row[c] == 0 and row[c - 1] != 0 and row[c + 1] == row[c - 1]:
                lanes.setdefault(c, []).append((r, row[c - 1]))
    for c, marks in lanes.items():
        start = 0
        for r, color in sorted(marks):
            for rr in range(start, r + 1):
                out[rr][c] = color
            start = r + 1
    return out
'''
